CustomField.description: Removed Family Structure from Formula after moving relevant fields to Case Record.
CustomField.formula:
HYPERLINK("https://na56.salesforce.com/"&Main_Client__r.Id,
if (isblank (Main_Client__r.MailingStreet) && isblank (Main_Client__r.MailingCity), "Primary Address; ", NULL)
& if (isblank (text(Main_Client__r.npe01__PreferredPhone__c)), "Contact Details; ", NULL)
& if (isblank(Main_Client__r.Emergency_Contact__c) && isblank(Main_Client__r.Emergency_Contact_Phone__c), "Emergency Contact; ", NULL)
& if (isblank (text (Main_Client__r.Race_Cara__c)) || isblank (text (Main_Client__r.Ethnicity__c)) || isblank (text (Main_Client__r.Gender__c)) || isblank (text (Main_Client__r.Neighborhood__c)) || isblank (text (Main_Client__r.Military_Status__c)), "Demographics; ", NULL)
& if (isblank (Main_Client__r.Birthdate), "Documentation; ", NULL))
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Click on link to fill in any missing sections listed here.
CustomField.label: Pending Entry on Client/Contact
